title: His Bedroom Suddenly Lost Gravity 😳 | ECHO//100 Episode 4
description:
Gravity collapses inside Kavi's sanctuary as he discovers the true, desperate nature of his pursuer. Episode 4 of ECHO//100: ARC. This content was generated with assistance from AI for original fiction.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The floor vanishes, slamming Kavi against the ceiling as the desk orbits overhead in silence.
scenes.caption: Gravity failure initiated
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Kavi in red hoodie and glasses pinned to ceiling, desk floating upside down, Byte hovering nearby, cinematic lighting.

scenes.text: Null’s shadow bleeds through the floorboards, consuming the bed in a swarm of digital static.
scenes.caption: Null invades the room
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, black purple glitch entity Null consuming furniture, Kavi looking down in terror from ceiling, Byte glowing bright cyan.

scenes.text: Kavi grabs Byte’s antenna, forcing the chaotic room to snap into a shimmering geometric grid.
scenes.caption: Reality stabilizes on touch
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Kavi’s hand touching Byte’s orange antenna, room turning into blue wireframe grid, Kavi looking determined.

scenes.text: Byte rewrites local physics, but the immense strain causes the cyan face to flicker warningly.
scenes.caption: Byte manipulating reality
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Byte glowing intensely, cyan face flickering, Kavi bracing against ceiling, room warping around them.

scenes.text: Null ceases the assault, red eyes focusing intently on the backpack instead of deleting Kavi.
scenes.caption: Null halts its assault
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Null pausing, red eyes glowing, Kavi clutching his backpack, Byte hovering between them.

scenes.text: The glitch speaks, claiming that absorbing Kavi remains the only way to stabilize the timeline.
scenes.caption: The truth about Null
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Null projecting a holographic red paradox warning, Kavi looking horrified, Byte emitting protective light.

scenes.text: Bedroom walls liquefy into digital dust, exposing the moonlit grass of the backyard beyond.
scenes.caption: Walls dissolving away
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, bedroom walls disintegrating into particles, Kavi looking out at his backyard, night sky visible.

scenes.text: Standing amidst the weeds, the massive Red Door looms, waiting for the key inside Kavi’s pocket.
scenes.caption: The Red Door appears
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, massive Red Door standing in backyard, Kavi standing in ruins of his room, moonlight illuminating the scene.
